entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Yeah, yeah, just get me someone. I need to make a return.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I just said, I need to return a helmet. What's the process? Just give me a yes or no.

I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could you provide your order number? And just to clarify, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's 113-89-ZULU. No fault. The color is just not what I expected. The box is still unopened, sitting in my closet. I just want my money back.
Okay, thank you for that information. Let me pull up your order. One moment... Okay, I see the Aero Road Helmet here. I just need to verify the purchase date to check the return eligibility.
Look, it's within the window. Just process it.

Yes, you are correct. I see the delivery was 81 days ago, and our policy allows for returns on standard items up to 90 days. We definitely want you to be satisfied with your gear, especially when it comes to an item critical for your safety.
Great. So what do I do?

I've just approved the return authorization. I am emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Simply attach it to the box and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive the item, you'll get a full refund.
Okay, perfect. The label is in my inbox. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
